The Echo of Sendai is a ghost of a drow Bhaalspawn. She was one of the members of the Five during the Bhaalspawn crisis.
“
HIS MOST FAITHFUL DEPARTED.
„
— Echo of Sendai


Overview

Backstory

In life, Sendai was once a Bhaalspawn and a member of the Five which was an alliance between five powerful Bhaalspawns formed by  Amelyssan, Bhaal's high priestess, who sought to slaughter their siblings in exchange for power. Like the rest of the Five, she was defeated in her enclave by her sibling and fellow Bhaalspawn, Gorion's Ward.

 Bhaal was  resurrected a century after Sendai's death. After this  Sarevok Anchev was able to bring her back as an Echo to serve in the Murder Tribunal along with  Abazigal,  Illasera and Amelyssan.

Involvement

Sendai is in the Murder Tribunal, where she accompanies  Sarevok. If the player character refuses to become an Unholy Assassin or performs any hostile actions she becomes hostile. If the player character instead completes ⁠Impress the Murder Tribunal and becomes an Unholy Assassin of Bhaal, she can be questioned to learn more about her history.

If the party chooses to fight the Murder Tribunal and the Echo of Sendai is destroyed before Sarevok, he gains the condition  Absorbed Essence: Sendai. If Sarevok is killed first, the Echo of Sendai gains  Retributive Justice instead.
